record.label: Enriched-J by pair-arm 2x2 factorial
record.summary: The observed fold-J-to-pair-on scale is 1.5976369307690381e-10, about 19.148% of the current-board deficit. Enriched-J factorial cells are absent, so representation capacity or its interaction with the pair arm remains an open hypothesis. DEPENDENCY UPDATE (2026-08-29): the only named enriched-J source class (support>=3 K6 difference-replica) is experimentally falsified at Gate 1. Enriched-J remains open only as a hypothesis awaiting a genuinely new source proposal that passes Gate-0 effect-size and sampled-variance arithmetic; no such proposal currently exists. REDUCED TO EXTERNAL CONSTRAINT (2026-08-29): raw <1e-8 through this lane requires a target-blind source carrying >=83.805 percent of the late-q innovation variance at the endpoint. Gate-0 pricing from measured constants closes every known source super-class: deterministic tapes <=0.5 percent actual and 10.5 percent oracle (two independent estimator lineages); sampled path statistics at any order >=33x the full 2^41 budget even granting the unbuildable free degree-64 oracle surrogate and the entire budget to the source (order-1 is the minimum-variance sampled observable at SE 1.04e-3 versus the required 3.01e-5; the K6 replica measured 324x over its gate); sampled control-variate hybrids floored at 2.85e-8. Reopening requires either an exact analytic late-layer propagation advance (the blocked P2R0F3B family's named external theorems) or a certified representation with >=1000x better per-flop information about the activation law than independent path sampling. No such object is known. SCOPE CORRECTION (2026-08-29, user-directed): the V13 external constraint covers learned-corrector source classes only. The deterministic construction route is reopened as P2R0G19 - per-layer truth is offline-computable from weights, so the blocker was never information but deployed-budget numerics.
record.terminal_criterion: Blocked on the external constraint in GATE0_PRICING.json: a source class outside deterministic tapes, sampled path statistics, and their hybrids, or an exact analytic late-layer propagation advance. Reopen only with a Gate-0-passing proposal.
